moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The XXIII Commonwealth Games are currently underway in Glasgow, Scotland, running from July 23 to August 2, 2026, with daily events and medal sessions.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are in full flow with medal events happening all weekend. Who are you cheering for? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Closing Ceremony Tease
angles.copy: Just a week left of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! Simple Minds are headlining the closing ceremony on August 2nd. What's been your highlight so far?

angles.name: Local Interest (Scotland)
angles.copy: Our city is hosting the Commonwealth Games, and the atmosphere is electric! Catch the latest from the events happening across Glasgow today. #Glasgow2026

moments.title: Love Island UK 2026 Finale
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated finale of Love Island UK 2026 is set to air on Monday, July 27, at 9 PM on ITV2 and ITVX, concluding eight weeks of reality TV drama.

angles.name: Finale Countdown
angles.copy: The Love Island UK final is TOMORROW! Who do you think will be crowned the winners and take home the £50k? Tune in Monday 9 PM on ITV2/ITVX.

angles.name: Host Tease
angles.copy: Maya Jama has teased a 'different format' for tomorrow's Love Island UK finale, saying even she doesn't know the full twist! What do you predict?

moments.title: UK August Weather Forecast
moments.blurb: Early August is expected to bring mixed, changeable weather conditions across the UK, with the potential for warmer, more settled conditions and heatwaves developing later in the month.

angles.name: Summer Outlook
angles.copy: The Met Office says early August looks a bit mixed, but there's potential for heatwaves later in the month! Keep those fingers crossed for sunshine.

angles.name: August Vibes
angles.copy: August is almost here, and while the start might be changeable, forecasts suggest warmer, drier spells could be on the way. What's your ideal summer weather?
